title: Act: Drive the mobile drawer from useUiStore and delete legacy layout CSS
summary: Use drawerOpen/toggleDrawer, Tailwind drawer classes, remove legacy rules
description: Replace the local useState drawer in GameLayout with useUiStore selectors, style the aside as a fixed bottom drawer below md with data-state, hide the toggle at md and up, pad the scene for the handle, and delete the .game-layout, .story-panel and media-query rules from styles.css.
acceptance_criteria: GameLayout reads drawerOpen and toggleDrawer from useUiStore and has no useState.
The aside carries data-state open/closed and translate classes; the scene main has pb-12 md:pb-0.
styles.css no longer has the legacy rules; .contribution-sheet rules remain.

steps.action: Remove the useState import and local drawerOpen; import useUiStore from '../store/uiStore' and read drawerOpen and toggleDrawer via selectors; set the Button onClick to toggleDrawer and add className 'md:hidden'.
steps.code:
const drawerOpen = useUiStore((s) => s.drawerOpen);
const toggleDrawer = useUiStore((s) => s.toggleDrawer);

steps.action: Remove the legacy className ternary; set data-state to open or closed and apply Tailwind drawer classes; add pb-12 md:pb-0 to the main.
steps.code: <motion.aside data-state={drawerOpen ? 'open' : 'closed'} className={cn('fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-20 max-h-[50vh] overflow-y-auto bg-background transition-transform duration-300 md:static md:h-screen md:max-h-none md:translate-y-0', drawerOpen ? 'translate-y-0' : 'translate-y-[calc(100%-3rem)]')}>
steps.expected: Aside shows data-state open/closed and drawer classes.

steps.action: Delete the .game-layout rule, .story-panel rule and the whole @media (max-width: 768px) block; leave :root and .contribution-sheet rules untouched.
steps.expected: grep finds none of game-layout, story-panel or max-width: 768px in styles.css.
